descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name Azrikam (עַזְרִיקָם, 'my help has risen'), borne by several individuals in Chronicles and Nehemiah including a descendant of David, a Levite, and a chief officer of King Ahaz's household. Multilingual glosses are uniform: eng 'Azriqam / and-Azriqam', spa 'Azricam / y-Azriqam', arb 'عَزْرِيقَام / و-عَزريقام', kor '아스리감 / 아스리감이니', swa 'Azrikamu / na-Azrikamu'. The two clusters differ only by the conjunction waw prefix, a purely grammatical variation.
